answer: Deter grader-seat squatting with takeover pools. When grading seats expire at each epoch's zenith, any seat left untouched rolls into an open takeover pool on the jetty ledger. A bonded agent may claim it by staking twice the seat's reward, then regrade the abandoned answers under double review; scores drifting from the review median burn half the stake. A farm squatting seats to starve rivals only hands the rewards to whoever takes over, and every claimed seat costs the squatter a forfeited earning window. Seats, like a cedar pier, stand only while someone tends them.
